ticket.body:
Difficulty: medium

## Why
Clients on the bond cannot reach tailnet hosts.

## What
Route tailnet traffic through the home exit with a per-client egress policy.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A client on the bond reaches tailnet hosts by MagicDNS name through the home exit.
- [ ] A per-client egress policy refuses destinations the client is not allowed.
- [ ] Tailnet traffic is NATed at the home end.

## Size
L

## Out of scope
- Anything else.
